message.content: {"answer": "B", "option_text": "The right-sided pneumothorax is the primary cause of increased shortness of breath and is associated with the bullous changes seen in the chest X-ray.", "reason": "Visual inspection of Figure 1 reveals a large right-sided pneumothorax (visible visceral pleural line with absent lung markings peripherally) and extensive bullous lung disease.
